title: Detection and quantification of nanoparticles in runoff from a highly trafficked urban motorway
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00552J, Paper
Malak Dia, Pierre-Emmanuel Peyneau, Denis Courtier-Murias, Béatrice Bechet
